brief: 5 free design tools every solo founder uses to ship pixel-perfect UI.

slots.desc1: Collaborative interface design tool with prototyping and dev handoff.
slots.desc2: Open-source design platform that runs entirely in your browser.
slots.desc3: Generate perfect color palettes in seconds with one click.
slots.desc4: Remove image backgrounds automatically with AI in under five seconds.
slots.desc5: Quality free fonts from Indian Type Foundry for commercial projects.

slots.toolTagline: The browser-based home for interface design and prototyping.
slots.bigStatement: Design anything from wireframes to dev-ready specs without leaving your browser.
slots.use1Body: Start with frames and auto-layout to build responsive components fast.
slots.use2Body: Link screens with smart animate to test flows before writing code.
slots.use3Body: Share inspect mode links so engineers grab CSS and assets instantly.

slots.toolTagline: Open-source design freedom built for cross-functional product teams.
slots.bigStatement: Own your designs completely with SVG-based files and zero vendor lock-in.
slots.use1Body: Run Penpot on your own server for total data privacy and control.
slots.use2Body: Use CSS-like layouts and flex properties that mirror real development workflows.
slots.use3Body: Multiple editors work on the same file simultaneously without subscription limits.

slots.toolTagline: Generate, lock, and export color palettes in seconds flat.
slots.bigStatement: Stop guessing colors; lock hues and export CSS variables instantly.
slots.use1Body: Hit the spacebar to cycle schemes until you find the perfect match.
slots.use2Body: Preview palette combinations against accessibility standards before shipping to production.
slots.use3Body: Download CSS, SCSS, or PNG swatches ready for Tailwind or Figma.

slots.toolTagline: AI-powered background removal for product shots and marketing assets.
slots.bigStatement: Create clean cutouts for hero images without touching Photoshop ever again.
slots.use1Body: Drop a snapshot and get a transparent PNG perfect for UI mockups.
slots.use2Body: Process dozens of team headshots or product images through the API or app.
slots.use3Body: Fine-tune edges with built-in brushes for hair and complex textures automatically.

slots.toolTagline: Beautiful commercial-use fonts from the Indian Type Foundry, totally gratis.
slots.bigStatement: Elevate UI typography with original font families that cost exactly zero dollars.
slots.use1Body: Curated collections of display and text fonts that work together harmoniously.
slots.use2Body: Tweak weight and width on the fly for responsive headline scaling in CSS.
slots.use3Body: Generate self-hostable kits with WOFF2 files and CSS snippets for instant setup.

slots.toolTagline: Advanced photo editor inside your browser that reads PSD files natively.
slots.bigStatement: Edit PSDs, export assets, and retouch photos without buying Adobe Creative Cloud.
slots.use1Body: Open Photoshop files directly in the browser to tweak layers and smart objects.
slots.use2Body: Slice and save PNG, SVG, or JPG elements for your design system instantly.
slots.use3Body: Use heal and clone tools to clean up screenshots and photography for UI.

slots.body: Stop paying for bloated software. This six-tool workflow covers wireframes to production assets.
